name: GMX Protected Character Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `ProtectedCharacterCount` category — the character count for text that has been marked as protected, or otherwise not translatable (for example XLIFF text enclosed in `<mrk mtype="protected">` elements). Unlike the match-based GMX steps, this step counts only the units flagged as non-translatable, counting characters in their source; for translatable units it removes any previously recorded protected metric. Characters are counted in canonical form — whitespace and punctuation are excluded (hyphens and apostrophes inside words are kept) — and stored as GMX-V metrics annotations for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the character-count counterpart of the protected word-count step.
processingNotes: Counts only text units marked non-translatable; this is the one GMX count step that does not restrict itself to translatable units.
For translatable units the step actively removes any existing protected metric from the segment, source, and text unit.
Character counting excludes whitespace and punctuation per GMX-V, but retains hyphens and apostrophes that occur inside a word.
